title: Unit Event — On the Stage of Dazzling Light — Episode7 Looking For Stars

meta.Event: On the Stage of Dazzling Light
meta.Event Outline: Ever since his visit to Riley Dream Park, Tsukasa has felt a desire to improve even more as an actor. In the troupe's new ambassadorial show, he takes on a character unlike any he has before, with a personality entirely opposite his own.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Saki
rows.Line:
<Tsukasa!
I got into Miya Girls Junior High!
Ichi and the girls all got in too!>

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Saki
rows.Line: <Thanks! This means we can keep hanging out and having fun together! Plus, I feel great!!>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is wonderful!! I'm so happy for you...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Tsukasa
rows.Line: We should throw you a party today! Why don't you invite Ichika and the others over?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Saki
rows.Line:
<Okay, I'll try asking them!
Talk to you later!>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Good for you, Saki...!
You get to be with your friends again...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
I feel like I can play anything right now!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, this is the Tenmas.
Wait, what happened to Saki...?!

rows.Speaker: Doctor
rows.Line: I know it's quite a ways away, but based on her condition, I recommend transferring her to the hospital in the other prefecture since they have a specialist in-house.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Tsukasa
rows.Line:
She just got into Miya Girls...
But she's being ripped away from it now...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(But I'm sure Saki will be fine...
She'll be back.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And I'll be waiting for her right here...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I know. In times like this, it's always nice to look at the stars...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, in times like this, there's but one thing for me to do!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting!
Everything okay, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Toya got worried because you were staring off into space like that, so he asked for it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're welcome. But more importantly, is everything okay...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes...
I think I know what those stars mean to Thorpe now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Stars? What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, that's it...
Saki, you were the one who said that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Seeing stars makes me feel better.”
Didn't you say that to me once when I visited your hospital room all those years ago?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, now that you mention it...
Yeah, I did used to say that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Every time I felt scared... Every time I had to go in for another test or surgery, I wanted to look up at the stars... But I also got scolded a lot for staying up too late.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I kept looking because they reminded me of all the fun things I did with Ichi and the girls, and the shows you put on for me, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
The answer was right under my nose this entire time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, I guess I still have a long way to go...! However, accepting that is always the first step towards growth!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Toya, Saki, thank you both very much! I believe I have a way out of this conundrum now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I do!
You two have been a massive help.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Especially since talking like this reminded me of some very precious memories. I have a feeling our show is going to turn out beautifully...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Really...?
I'm glad I could help.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If you'd like, why don't you and your friends stop by for a showing? I promise to make it a great one!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “And so, the animals all celebrated Thorpe's triumph as he was welcomed in as the band's new pianist. The end.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (There isn't much time left until we open...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (If we wait any longer, we won't have a chance to put a polish on our show.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa's gonna be fine! I'm sure of it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I apologize for taking so long...
I'm sure I had you all worried.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I finally figured out what I have in common with Thorpe and know how to get into character now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, you certainly had us worried there for a second, oh dear troupe leader...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, let's start from the top.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Tsukasa, we have everything just about nailed down, so it'll be up to you to keep everything going.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So be it!
I feel completely invulnerable right now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I have a suggestion regarding the part when I'm on the piano...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A suggestion? Alright, let's hear it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank goodness Tsukasa managed to figure out how to play Thorpe!!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm just as glad.
I think he's taken a major step towards making his dreams come true.
